### 聊天、检索与文件柜 / Chat, search and file cabinets

- **从通讯录开始第一段对话**。首次打开聊天页可直接找同事。尚未发现联系人时，可复制本机 IP 或按 IP 添加对方。聊天输入区提示离线文字的送达方式，连续发出的成功文字折叠重复回执，点击小勾即可查看单条状态。
- 聊天记录可按会话、消息类型、发送人和日期筛选。按 Ctrl+F（macOS 上为 ⌘F）查找当前会话，点击结果可定位聊天原文。
- 「我的文件柜」集中展示共享目录、访问权限和最近收到的文件。窄面板会把大小和时间移到文件名下方。
- 统一了聊天、设置、截图、看图和屏幕协助窗口的控件反馈，并改善键盘焦点、长文字及深色主题下的可读性。

- **Start a conversation from Contacts.** When no colleagues appear, copy your IP or add a colleague by address. Chat explains offline text delivery. Consecutive outgoing texts use compact receipts that you can open individually.
- Filter chat history by conversation, message type, sender or date. Use Ctrl+F (⌘F on macOS) to search the current chat and select a result to jump to the original message.
- My Cabinet brings shared files, access permissions and recent uploads together. In narrow panes, file sizes and timestamps appear below the filename.
- Chat, settings, capture, image viewing and screen assistance now have more consistent control states, with improvements to keyboard focus, long text and dark-theme readability.
